primary_claim: Most safety-relevant properties in Gemini (across ODCV, alignment/eval-awareness, safety, reward-hacking, and free-tier-log benchmarks) are established by pretraining plus SFT alone, not by later RL training stages: SFT-only checkpoints of Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash perform remarkably similarly to the corresponding production models across these evals.

effect.metric: safety-relevant benchmark scores, SFT-only vs production (post-RL) model
effect.value: SFT-only and production models score remarkably similarly across ODCV, alignment evals, safety evals, reward hacking, and free-tier user log benchmarks

contradicts_or_qualifies: Runs counter to the authors' own initial expectations that RL training stages would be the primary driver of safety-relevant properties
stated_future_work: intervene at the SFT stage in future work on Gemini safety and behavior, given it is identified as a high-leverage point
limitations_stated: the authors do not want to overstate this claim as applying to other model families
this result may change in future Gemini versions
many autorater positives in the free-tier user log analysis are likely false positives
quote: most safety relevant properties in Gemini seem to be caused by the combination of pretraining and SFT, not other training stages like RL
